c74object.name: ear.objects~
c74object.digest: Render a mono ADM audio object to loudspeaker signals with libear (ITU-R BS.2127)
c74object.description: Render a mono ADM audio object to loudspeaker signals with libear (ITU-R BS.2127). One signal outlet per loudspeaker of the BS.2051 layout given as argument. Direct and diffuse gains are interpolated; the diffuse part is passed through the BS.2127 decorrelation filters and the direct part is delay-compensated.

method.name: azimuth
method.description: Set the azimuth attribute. Polar azimuth in degrees; 0 is front, positive values turn anticlockwise (to the left).

method.name: cartesian
method.description: Set the cartesian attribute. Use cartesian coordinates (x y z) instead of polar (azimuth elevation distance). This also selects which divergence parameters are used.

method.name: channellock
method.description: Set the channellock attribute. Snap the object to the nearest loudspeaker (see channellock_distance).

method.name: channellock_distance
method.description: Set the channellock_distance attribute. Maximum distance to a loudspeaker for channel lock to apply; 0 means unlimited.

method.name: channels
method.digest: Post the channel names of the layout to the Max console
method.description: Post the channel names of the layout to the Max console.

method.name: decorrelate
method.description: Set the decorrelate attribute. Pass the diffuse part through the BS.2127 decorrelation filters and delay-compensate the direct part (adds 255 samples of latency). When off, direct and diffuse gains are simply summed.

method.name: depth
method.description: Set the depth attribute. Object extent: depth (distance units).

method.name: diffuse
method.description: Set the diffuse attribute. Diffuseness from 0 (all direct) to 1 (all diffuse, sent through decorrelation filters).

method.name: distance
method.description: Set the distance attribute. Polar distance (0 to 1; 1 is at the loudspeakers).

method.name: divergence
method.description: Set the divergence attribute. Object divergence from 0 (none) to 1 (fully split into two virtual sources).

method.name: divergence_range
method.description: Set the divergence_range attribute. Divergence spread: azimuth range in degrees (polar) or position range (cartesian).

method.name: elevation
method.description: Set the elevation attribute. Polar elevation in degrees; positive values are above the listener.

method.name: gain
method.description: Set the gain attribute. Linear gain applied to the object.

method.name: height
method.description: Set the height attribute. Object extent: height in degrees (polar) or units (cartesian).

method.name: layout
method.description: Set the layout attribute. ITU-R BS.2051 loudspeaker layout name, such as 0+2+0, 0+5+0, 2+5+0, 4+5+0, 4+9+0, 9+10+3. Send 'layouts' to list all names. Signal objects fix the layout at creation time.

method.name: list
method.digest: Set the position: azimuth elevation and optional distance (polar) or x y z (cartesian)
method.description: Set the position: azimuth elevation and optional distance (polar) or x y z (cartesian).

method.name: ramp
method.description: Set the ramp attribute. Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when the metadata changes.

method.name: screenedgelock_h
method.description: Set the screenedgelock_h attribute. Lock the horizontal position to a screen edge: none, left or right.

method.name: screenedgelock_v
method.description: Set the screenedgelock_v attribute. Lock the vertical position to a screen edge: none, top or bottom.

method.name: screenref
method.description: Set the screenref attribute. Apply screen scaling relative to the reference screen (the default ADM screen).

method.name: width
method.description: Set the width attribute. Object extent: width in degrees (polar) or units (cartesian).

method.name: x
method.description: Set the x attribute. Cartesian X (-1 left to 1 right).

method.name: y
method.description: Set the y attribute. Cartesian Y (-1 back to 1 front).

method.name: z
method.description: Set the z attribute. Cartesian Z (-1 below to 1 above).

method.name: zone
method.digest: Add an exclusion zone: 'zone polar minAzimuth maxAzimuth minElevation maxElevation' or 'zone cartesian minX maxX minY maxY minZ maxZ'
method.description: Add an exclusion zone: 'zone polar minAzimuth maxAzimuth minElevation maxElevation' or 'zone cartesian minX maxX minY maxY minZ maxZ'. Loudspeakers inside the zones are not used; 'zone clear' removes all zones.

attribute.description: Polar azimuth in degrees; 0 is front, positive values turn anticlockwise (to the left). Default: 0.

attribute.description: Use cartesian coordinates (x y z) instead of polar (azimuth elevation distance). This also selects which divergence parameters are used. Default: 0.

attribute.description: Snap the object to the nearest loudspeaker (see channellock_distance). Default: 0.

attribute.description: Polar distance (0 to 1; 1 is at the loudspeakers). Default: 1.

attribute.description: Object divergence from 0 (none) to 1 (fully split into two virtual sources). Range: 0 to 1. Default: 0.

attribute.description: Divergence spread: azimuth range in degrees (polar) or position range (cartesian). Default: 45.

attribute.description: Polar elevation in degrees; positive values are above the listener. Default: 0.

attribute.description: Linear gain applied to the object. Default: 1.

attribute.name: height
attribute.digest: Object extent: height in degrees (polar) or units (cartesian)
attribute.description: Object extent: height in degrees (polar) or units (cartesian). Default: 0.

attribute.description: Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when the metadata changes. Default: 10.

attribute.description: Lock the horizontal position to a screen edge: none, left or right. Default: none.

attribute.description: Lock the vertical position to a screen edge: none, top or bottom. Default: none.

attribute.description: Apply screen scaling relative to the reference screen (the default ADM screen). Default: 0.

attribute.description: Object extent: width in degrees (polar) or units (cartesian). Default: 0.

attribute.description: Cartesian X (-1 left to 1 right). Default: 0.
